display_name.label: Business name
display_name.help: The name your documents, emails and pages show, in each language. At most 80 characters.

logo.label: Logo
logo.help: A PNG or JPEG file, at most 512 KB. SVG files are not accepted.

mark.label: Square mark
mark.help: A square PNG or JPEG, 512 × 512 pixels or larger. Your logo is used when you leave this empty.

primary_color.label: Primary colour
primary_color.help: A hex colour such as #1D4ED8. White or black text on it must reach a contrast of 4.5:1.

accent_color.label: Accent colour
accent_color.help: A hex colour for titles and lines. It must reach a contrast of 3:1 against white.

brand_color_contrast.message: This colour's contrast is {ratio}:1. It needs at least {minimum}:1.
